name: translator
description: Translate text between languages (auto-detects source by default), detect what language a text is written in, translate multiple texts at once, list supported languages, or transliterate text between writing systems (e.g. Latin to Cyrillic).

action.description: translate: convert text from one language to another. detect_language: identify what language text is in. translate_batch: translate multiple texts at once. list_languages: see supported language codes. transliterate: convert between writing systems.

text.description: Text to translate/detect/transliterate. Required for translate, detect_language, transliterate.

source_lang.description: Source language code (e.g. 'es', 'fr') or 'auto' to detect. Defaults to 'auto'. Used for action='translate'.

target_lang.description: Target language code (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'yo'). REQUIRED to specify explicitly - defaulting silently to English regardless of what the user actually wants was the original bug here. Used for translate and translate_batch.

from_script.description: Source writing system, e.g. 'Latin'. Required for action='transliterate'.

to_script.description: Target writing system, e.g. 'Cyrillic'. Required for action='transliterate'.
